justification: Opening frame establishes Distinctive Audio as calm high-end listening rather than retail noise, leaving generous negative space for the hero claim and primary actions.
canvas: A pale blue-white listening gallery with a single matte-black floorstanding loudspeaker on brass feet set to the right, polished concrete reflecting its silhouette, and an empty left wall held in quiet reserve.
dom_choreography: Hero copy pins over the empty left half while the speaker remains right-weighted; primary and secondary CTAs enter after the first 35vh without covering the subject.
transition_out: Slow lateral drift into a closer acoustic plane; floor reflection stretches toward the next room seam.
camera: Low wide-normal camera at seated listening height, framed with subject right and blank wall left.
light: Soft circular skylight wash from above with a faint cool wall gradient and no colour shift.
subject_state: Single loudspeaker standing silent, precise, and newly revealed.

justification: Signature beat proves the page core claim: Distinctive Audio designs the whole listening experience by aligning system, room, and long-term support.
canvas: Three matte-black hi-fi forms—source, amplifier, and speaker—sit apart in the gallery while a restrained gold line of light travels across their brass edges and resolves into one coherent listening axis on the floor.
dom_choreography: Approach heading and paragraph pin in the open upper-left field; the three service ideas can stagger over the lower-left as the gold alignment completes behind them.
transition_out: Gold line fades back to edge catches only; camera glides past the aligned axis into a wider product field.
camera: Seated-height dolly move from slight left offset to centered alignment on the system axis.
light: Same cool skylight with one scripted gold glint tracing the signal path for this beat only.
subject_state: Separated components becoming a tuned system in one room.

justification: A production-efficient overview beat supports category discovery without creating separate concepts for each product family.
canvas: Four restrained plinths recede across the pale gallery, each holding a different black hi-fi silhouette: a turntable platter, an integrated amplifier face, a speaker column, and a compact digital source.
dom_choreography: Category links and product labels occupy the left and lower negative spaces in sequence; DOM can snap between category groups while the still remains stable.
transition_out: The plinth row falls into soft focus as the camera passes toward a warmer, more personal listening corner.
camera: Calm three-quarter wide-normal view looking diagonally across the plinths with foreground floor space preserved.
light: Even skylight with tiny gold edge catches on knobs, feet, and platter rim only.
subject_state: Product families arranged as a curated collection, not a catalogue wall.

justification: The page shifts from equipment to personal curation; this beat gives the owner story a physical analogue without showing UI or literal biography graphics.
canvas: A quiet audition table in the same gallery holds a black component under soft daylight, a pair of white cotton gloves, a small brass alignment weight, and a chair just pulled back from listening position.
dom_choreography: Biography copy floats in the open wall area above the table; the read-more link appears after the chair and tabletop objects settle into view.
transition_out: Tabletop highlights dim slightly and the view wipes through a vertical wall seam into service content.
camera: Static medium-wide frame at table height with tabletop low and broad blank wall above.
light: Soft skylight from high right, creating delicate reflections on the component face and brass weight.
subject_state: A curated system in mid-audition, implying expert human selection just outside frame.

justification: The address band is informational and does not need a new production frame; it can bridge the personal story and service offer.
canvas: No new still; hold the pale gallery atmosphere as a quiet spacer between cinematic beats.
dom_choreography: Address text crosses over a simple colour band or transparent spacer while the prior room seam completes; avoid adding parallax subjects.
transition_out: Direct DOM fade into the services section rhythm.
camera: No camera move; continue prior alignment.

justification: Listening demos and custom cables are specific service cards that can be handled by DOM motion; the signature system-design claim has already been proven.
canvas: No new still; retain the existing gallery as a neutral acoustic backdrop with no additional equipment emphasis.
dom_choreography: Service blocks rise in clean staggered motion over open negative space; icons and text stay DOM-led with no new 3D scene requirement.
transition_out: DOM content clears upward into the final invitation frame.
camera: No camera move; neutral locked perspective.

justification: Final invitation deserves a closing frame because it converts the designed-experience story into a showroom appointment.
canvas: The gallery opens into a listening position: two black speakers stand far apart, a single low chair faces them from the foreground edge, and a soft gold reflection marks the exact listening spot on the floor.
dom_choreography: Closing heading pins above the empty chair zone; booking CTA lands in the clear central negative space without covering the speakers.
transition_out: Hold to black-teal footer colour or dissolve to the standard page footer.
camera: Centered seated-height perspective from just behind the listener position, symmetrical but not theatrical.
light: Cool skylight stays constant with a modest gold floor catch at the listening point only.
subject_state: Room ready for a private audition, waiting for the visitor.

justification: The quick-link cluster is navigational support and should remain DOM-only to preserve the 30-day production budget.
canvas: No new still; let the scene recede so the page can return to standard site navigation.
dom_choreography: Links appear as ordinary DOM content over a stable surface colour; no pinned scene or camera continuation needed.
camera: No camera move; scene has ended.
light: Light falls away to the site footer treatment.
